rules.sentence: When the platelet count falls below 20 × 109/L, clinically important spontaneous hemorrhage occurs.
Spontaneous microbleeds can frequently be seen in patients with platelet counts <30 × 109.
CMBs occur more in ITP with longer duration and lower nadir platelet counts.
This syndrome is caused by the loss of clotting factors and platelets, faulty and stimulated fibrinolysis, and a deterioration of the coagulation inhibition mechanism.
The cause of mortality in DIC patients is multi-organ dysfunction and severe bleeding.

There are different treatment modalities to treat DIC along with treating the underlying conditions, including blood transfusion in massive bleeding, heparin in non-symptomatic DIC, synthetic proteases inhibitor, and antifibrinolytic in symptomatic DIC, natural proteases inhibitors in organ failure DIC.
